stops.note: literally under one's control, from a phrase meaning to put under someone's jurisdiction, later to release from it
stops.meaning: under one's control, or released from it

stops.note: first recorded before 1393 in the work of the poet John Gower, who also wrote whole works in French and Latin
stops.meaning: to give up or leave something completely

current_meaning: to give up on or leave something or someone completely
